build_varint_encoder: build a varint encoder that serializes an integer value into protobuf wire format bytes
compute_varint_size: compute the byte size of a varint encoded value given an integer input
encode_string_field: encode a string field into protobuf wire format with UTF-8 encoding and length prefix
encode_message_field: encode a nested protobuf message field with its tag and length-delimited wire format
encode_map_field: encode a protobuf map field by iterating over key-value pairs and serializing each entry
